Delicious Food and a Great Family Dinner
Jun 2026 • Family
We ate at Bếp Mẹ Ỉn in Ho Chi Minh City on June 3rd, and our whole family really enjoyed the experience. The food was delicious, the restaurant was clean, and the atmosphere was welcoming and comfortable.
The bánh xèo was amazing! Crispy, flavorful. We especially loved that it came with rice paper wrappers that were ready to use and you didn’t have to dip them in water to soften them. It made wrapping the crispy bánh xèo so easy and enjoyable. Dipping saucecwas delicious and on point! The flavors were delicious, and it was definitely one of our favorite dishes.
Everything we ordered was very good, and we were happy with our choice to eat here.
A great place to enjoy Vietnamese food with family. We would definitely come back!

Dear ECU13,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us.

While we are sorry to hear that your experience resulted in a 2-star rating, we truly appreciate your honest perspective. You are right in noting that our menu takes a unique approach—at Bếp Mẹ Ỉn, we aim to combine traditional Vietnamese street food roots with contemporary twists to offer a modern dining experience. We understand that this style may not appeal to everyone, especially those seeking strictly traditional recipes.

That said, we are delighted that our service team left a positive impression with their friendly and attentive care. Providing a warm and welcoming environment is something we take great pride in.

We value your feedback as it helps us refine our guest experience, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future.

Warm regards,
